name: Password reset token disclosed in response
description:
The response to a password reset request carries the reset token itself. The token is meant to reach only the account owner, through the account's email address or phone; returning it to whoever asked for the reset lets anyone reset the password of any account they can name, which is a full account takeover.

burpsy reports this only when the value in the response is the token mailed to the test identity for the same request, or when using it in the confirm step succeeded where random tokens of the same shape failed.

This row is burpsy's own: Burp's issue catalogue has no password-reset rows.
remediation: Deliver the token only through the out-of-band channel. The reset request's response must be identical whether or not the account exists and must never carry the token or the reset link.

references.title: OWASP WSTG: Testing for Weak Password Change or Reset Functionalities (WSTG-ATHN-09)
